hypothesis: Once per week, the strongest positive 30-day asset above its own 100-day trend continues upward while the weakest negative asset below its trend continues downward over the next seven days.
data_status: Static five-asset Binance history is project-seen and survivor-biased; results are development diagnostics only.

rules.signal_time: Monday 00:00 UTC on a completed 4h candle
rules.long: rank 5, positive 30-day return, close above SMA100
rules.short: rank 1, negative 30-day return, close below SMA100

prohibited: changing lookback, trend, rebalance day, stop, or holding period after seeing results
dropping losing assets or one direction after seeing results
claiming final OOS from the static project-seen universe
using leverage to force the monthly target
